entities.name: Query CoaBC enzyme
observations: 400 aa soluble enzyme sequence; predicted molecular weight 41.63 kDa and pI 5.59.
Shares 49.5% identity over 96.8% query coverage with reviewed Mycobacterium CoaBC proteins; E-value 3.3e-104.
Contains Pfam Flavoprotein domain PF02441 at residues 2–176 and DFP domain PF04127 at residues 183–391.
Strongly supports a bifunctional coenzyme A biosynthesis enzyme catalyzing EC 6.3.2.5 and EC 4.1.1.36.
Inferred cofactors are FMN and Mg2+; exact cofactor binding for the query is homology-based.
Likely catalyzes sequential formation and decarboxylation of N-(4-phosphopantothenoyl)-L-cysteine to produce 4'-phosphopantetheine and CO2.

entities.name: Mycobacterium CoaBC
observations: Reviewed reference proteins P67734, P9WNZ0, and P9WNZ1 are annotated as bifunctional CoaBC enzymes.
The reference proteins catalyze CoA biosynthesis steps 2 and 3 of 5 and are homododecamers in at least one curated annotation.
Reference domain organization places phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase at residues 1–195 and phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase at residues 196–418.

entities.name: CoaBC cysteine ligation
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+.
Annotated as EC 6.3.2.5 and Rhea RHEA:19397.
Requires Mg2+ according to reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: CoaBC decarboxylation
observations: Annotated as EC 4.1.1.36 and Rhea RHEA:16793.
FMN is annotated as a bound cofactor in reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme participates in CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate, specifically pathway steps 2 and 3 of 5.
